    Import and Export

    Data is saved in this local browser only.
    Use the Import/Export features to move your data between Devices and Browsers.
    - JSON (.json): full data backup; re-importable to other Devices/Browsers.
    - Markdown (.md): structured text; use for pretty rendering or HTML based applications.
    - Rich Text (.rtf): formatted text; for word processors with basic formatting.
    - Plain Text (.txt): simple text; used anywhere, useful for basic notes.

    JSON restores your full map. Text exports are for sharing, notes, or printing.

    Data Reset

    Documentation

    1. Tap a state to mark it. In cycle mode, a first tap on an already marked state shows it in Notes; the next tap cycles levels.
    2. Use the State Map header to switch labels, fit the map for screenshots, show or hide Legend and Notes, and drag the divider on desktop to resize the map and cards.
    3. Use the Legend to edit level names, definitions, colors, order, and whether a level counts toward stats.
    4. Click a Legend level to filter Notes by that level. Click it again to clear the filter.
    5. Use Notes search to find locations by name, type, level, dates, visit tags, or note details.
    6. Sort Notes chronologically or alphabetically, and turn on Categorical to group City, State, and Territory locations with sticky section headers.
    7. Use Expanded, Condensed, or Text Only view. Condensed is column-balanced for quick scanning, and Text Only is selectable with a copy button for Apple Notes.
    8. Use Smart Convert in the note editor to turn a quick note into dates, levels, location specifics, people, purpose, and details.
    9. Use Location Tags to add icon labels to notes. Settings lets you rename, reorder, shortcut, and search the optional circle icon catalog.
    10. Use the eye button in Notes to show or hide locations that only have levels excluded from stats.
    11. Add dates as a year, month and year, or full date. Settings controls the display order and month-name vs numeric formatting.
    12. Use JSON Import/Export in Settings to back up data or move it to another device. Text exports are for sharing or saving elsewhere.

    Default levels: Visited and Not Interested. Not Interested is the opt-out level and is excluded from total completion.

    Color tools: Auto Colors can apply a smart palette to your current levels. Suggested categories can be shown or hidden from the Legend.

    Structured notes: Notes can include Where Specifically, What For, Who With, Additional Details, and multiple icon labels. Use the Tags button in the note editor or Settings to choose, rename, sort, shortcut, and search optional labels from the circle icon catalog.

    What's New: Returning users may see a compact banner and red dots when a major feature release is available. Open What's New or dismiss the banner to clear it.

    Export formats: JSON (.json) is a full backup, re-importable into this app. Markdown (.md) renders in Obsidian, Notion, or any Markdown viewer. Rich Text (.rtf) opens in Word or Pages. Simple Text (.txt) pastes anywhere.

    Shortcut overlays: Hold Shift + Control + Option to show temporary hint badges on actionable controls.

    FAQ

    Where is my data saved?
    In your browser localStorage on this device only. Nothing leaves your machine.

    Can someone else use the same app link?
    Yes. Each browser keeps its own separate local copy of the data.

    Does it work offline?
    Yes. Once the file is open, no network connection is needed — there's no backend or external service.

    Can I move data to another device?
    Export a JSON backup in Settings, then import it in the app on the other device.

    Can I undo a reset?
    No. Export a JSON backup first if you want a safety net.

    What does Categorical do in Notes?
    It groups locations by City, State, and Territory, keeps your Alphabetical or Chronological sort inside each group, and keeps the current group header sticky while you scroll.

    What is Text Only view for?
    It renders a clean plain-text version of the current Notes view that is easy to select, copy, and paste into Apple Notes. Single-note locations stay on one line when possible.

    How does Smart Convert work?
    Type a quick note in the note editor, then Auto Convert fills any recognized date, level, visit icon, where, what, and who fields. Any leftover text goes to Additional Details.

    Can one note have multiple visit icons?
    Yes. Pick any labels that fit, though four or fewer keeps Notes rows easier to scan.

    Where do the extra Location Tags come from?
    More Icons is built from the circle symbols bundled into this file. Search by icon name, label, or related terms, then add the ones you want.

    What's the difference between cycle and select mode?
    Cycle taps rotate through your active levels automatically. Select mode opens a picker so you can choose a level and add a note in one step.

    Can I have more than five levels?
    No. Five is the cap — enough for any reasonable visit taxonomy without turning the legend into a spreadsheet.

    Why do some levels show a no symbol instead of a percentage?
    Those levels are excluded from completion stats.

    Can I use this offline?
    Yes. It is a single local HTML app with no backend and no external services.
